tools.name: search
tools.description: Search everything public on hangel (NGOs, events, volunteering, open funding calls, stores, products, library, platform pages) by keyword. Returns ids for the fetch tool.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full public record for an id returned by search (e.g. "ngo:<id>", "event:<slug>", "volunteer:<id>", "fund:<id>", "store:<slug>", "product:<id>", "library:<slug>", "page:/about").

tools.name: search_ngos
tools.description: Find NGOs (associations/foundations) on hangel by keyword, city, cause area or minimum transparency score.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List upcoming and ongoing public events by NGOs, student clubs and institutions, optionally filtered by keyword, city or online-only.

tools.name: list_volunteering
tools.description: List open volunteering opportunities, optionally filtered by keyword, city, online/remote, or urgent only.

tools.name: list_open_funds
tools.description: List grant and funding calls that are currently open for applications (deadline, provider, support amount, focus areas).

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search hangel Market products (millions of items from partner stores). Buying through hangel turns a share of the price (donationRate %) into a donation to an NGO of the buyer's choice.

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: List partner stores on hangel Market with their donation rate (% of each purchase donated to an NGO), highest first.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search the hangel civil-society library: legislation, document templates, data and research summaries, academic articles, social impact inventory, books, films, glossary.

tools.name: platform_info
tools.description: What hangel is, how donation-through-shopping works, who it is for, supported languages, key public pages and library sections.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
